title: Boot recovery of an already queued mailbox wake stamps an unchanged session
outcome: Recovering an unread mailbox wake already covered by a retained request or identical durable queued wake leaves the session mutation stamp unchanged and avoids first-tick transcript replay; real wake queue changes remain stamped and durable.
acceptance: A boot recovery fixture whose unread mailbox boundary is already covered by a retained request or identical queued wake leaves that session out of the zero-watermark persist delta.
A control fixture with a genuinely new or changed mailbox wake still selects and persists the queue update, preserving retained-head and durability ordering.
